title: Super Mario Bros. Edition
description: [WIP] Changes the textures from Minecraft to the style of Super Mario Bros. from 1985.
body:
**Minecraft: Super Mario Bros. Edition** is a WIP Resource Pack that changes the environment of Minecraft to feel more like Super Mario Bros. The pack focuses more on blocks than items, so until most blocks have been changed, most items will retain the vanilla textures.

If you are adding another texture pack with this one, place the resource pack ABOVE this one.
